input.quote: 16.4 Allocation. In the event a claim falls with the scope of the indemnity given by each Party, any payments in connection with such claim shall be apportioned between the Parties in accordance with the degree of fault attributable to each Party.
input.rationale: No insurance covenant exists anywhere in the Agreement: searches for "insurance"/"insur*"/"coverage" return only Net Sales deduction items (p0101, p0102) and "insurrection" in force majeure (p0763). Article 16 (p0715–p0727) provides reciprocal indemnities, a damages disclaimer and recall allocation, and Article 18 General Provisions (p0759–p0796) contains no insurance requirement, so the indemnities from Array — who manufactures and supplies Product (Article IX), sponsors Clinical Studies and receives our Confidential Information — are unbacked by any coverage requirement. This falls below even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M). We therefore insert a short Section 18.15 in the miscellaneous section at the preferred limits, noting that in a pharma licence equivalent coverage is sometimes carried under the Quality/Supply Agreements (p0772), which Array may evidence instead.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 18.15 (Insurance) requiring Array to carry general liability, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation coverage and to provide certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains reciprocal indemnities but no insurance covenant, so we have added a short insurance provision requiring Array to carry customary coverage (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where it processes our data, and statutory workers' compensation) with certificates on request. If Array prefers, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M, or confirm equivalent coverage is carried under the Quality and Supply Agreements.

ops.text: 18.15 Insurance. Array shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance (including product liability and contractual liability coverage) of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where Array processes Ono Confidential Information or personal data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Array shall provide Ono with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
